content: What do you need from me? Speak clearly.
I want to know why you're contacting me. What's this about?
Let me be clear: if you say a word about this to anyone, the people close to you won't be so lucky.
You're threatening my family? That's crossing a line. What do you want from me?
Silence. That's all. One wrong move, and they'll pay the price you can't imagine.
This isn't just about me, then. What exactly do I have to do to keep them safe?
Do what I say, and nobody gets hurt. Fail, and you'll regret ever hearing from me.
